lottery-gas-pump-win.title: A broken gas pump brought a man a million-dollar lottery win
lottery-gas-pump-win.summary: For a North Carolina resident, a broken gas pump at a filling station brought a $2 million prize. UPI says the cause was a faulty printing device on the pump, because of which the man bought a ticket and later won Powerball. It is a rare case in which a technical malfunction turned into a major prize.
lottery-gas-pump-win.picture: The image shows a gas pump and a lottery ticket. It suggests accidental luck that came through an ordinary household breakdown.

articles.title: Gas pump malfunction leads N.C. man to $2M lottery prize

window-seat-lawsuit.title: The airline will face a lawsuit over ‘windows without windows’
window-seat-lawsuit.summary: Delta Air Lines must answer in court to a lawsuit over ‘window seats’ that do not have windows. Reuters reports that passengers are challenging the sale of such seats as window seats, even though there was no porthole beside them. The court allowed the case to continue.
window-seat-lawsuit.picture: The airplane window in the image is shown without a view. It symbolizes the complaint that the promised seat was not what it was sold as.

articles.title: Delta Air Lines must face lawsuit over 'window seats' that have no windows - Reuters

zoo-atlanta-pandas-return.title: Giant pandas are returning to the Atlanta zoo
zoo-atlanta-pandas-return.summary: Giant pandas are returning to the Atlanta zoo. The Atlanta Journal-Constitution says the animals will arrive on Friday and explains what needs to be known about their return. It is a major event for the zoo and its visitors.
zoo-atlanta-pandas-return.picture: The image shows two giant pandas and bamboo. It is an image of the long-awaited return of rare animals to the zoo.

articles.title: Giant pandas are returning Friday to Zoo Atlanta. Here are 5 things to know. - The Atlanta Journal-Constitution

mystery-nose-down-jet.title: Experts examine the mysterious nose-down crash of a plane
mystery-nose-down-jet.summary: Experts and investigators are looking into the causes of the crash of a small Learjet that went down nose-first in the Greenacres area. According to USA Today and CNN, the NTSB is leading the investigation; the reports note that all nine people on board died. The case matters because investigators are searching for the key clue that will explain why the plane suddenly plunged into the ground.
mystery-nose-down-jet.picture: The image shows a small jet diving nose-first. This image emphasizes the suddenness and mystery of the disaster.

articles.title: 'Huge clue'? Experts unravel a mysterious, tragic nose-down jet crash - USA Today

blue-origin-delay.title: Blue Origin has once again pushed back the launch of New Glenn
blue-origin-delay.summary: Blue Origin has once again postponed the launch of its heavy New Glenn rocket — now to January 2027, whereas Jeff Bezos had previously named December 2026. CNBC says the company is rushing to restore the damaged launch pad after a destructive explosion, while the Financial Times notes that Blue Origin is lagging behind SpaceX. Reuters and Bloomberg coverage, as recounted by TASS, also says the launch has been moved to January.
blue-origin-delay.picture: A rocket is drawn beside the launch tower, ready for liftoff. The image conveys the delay in launch and the mission’s dependence on the condition of the launch infrastructure.

articles.title: Bloomberg: Blue Origin отложила запуск тяжелой ракеты New Glenn на январь
Blue Origin pushes launch to January 2027 as it races to rebuild damaged launch pad - CNBC
Blue Origin delays launches until 2027

crocodiles-arrive.title: A zoo has received its first pair of crocodiles in five years
crocodiles-arrive.summary: The Buffalo Zoo has received a pair of crocodiles for the first time in five years. A Buffalo Toronto Public Media report does not provide details about the animals themselves, but stresses that this is the first such addition in a long time.
crocodiles-arrive.picture: The image shows two crocodiles on a transport crate. It shows their recent delivery to the zoo.

articles.title: Buffalo Zoo welcomes pair of crocodiles for first time in five years - Buffalo Toronto Public Media

earthquake-drill-robot.title: Students built a game about a red panda for the zoo
earthquake-drill-robot.summary: Teenagers created the video game Red Panda Rush for the Maryland Zoo. WBAL-TV reports that the students made the project specifically for the zoo; the red panda is at the center of the game.
earthquake-drill-robot.picture: The image shows a game controller and a red panda. It links the digital game to its main animal character.

articles.title: Teens build 'Red Panda Rush' video game for Maryland Zoo - WBAL-TV

bob-dylan-vatican.title: Pope Leo received Bob Dylan at the Vatican
bob-dylan-vatican.summary: Pope Leo XIV received Bob Dylan at the Vatican. AP, NYT, BBC and NPR agree that the meeting was brief; according to The New York Times, Dylan arrived in a hoodie and a polka-dot tie, and there was no singing. The reports also note that the visit fell between Dylan’s concerts in Italy.
bob-dylan-vatican.picture: The image shows Bob Dylan and a portrait of the pope. It alludes to the rare meeting between the musician and the head of the Catholic Church.

joshua-wong-sentenced.title: Joshua Wong has been sentenced again in Hong Kong
joshua-wong-sentenced.summary: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong has once again been sentenced to prison in a national security case. Reuters, AP, BBC, NYT, NPR and other media report a 10-year sentence; The Guardian notes that this is his second prosecution under the law, and the reports also mention charges of conspiracy with foreign forces. The case is important as another example of pressure on the pro-democracy movement in Hong Kong.
joshua-wong-sentenced.picture: The image shows a protest placard and prison bars. It visually connects street protest with imprisonment.

meteor-shower-fireballs.title: Residents will be able to see bright fireball meteors
meteor-shower-fireballs.summary: The peak of the Southern Taurids meteor shower has begun, and observers may catch rare bright fireballs. CNN and National Geographic say that tonight the “shooting stars” may be especially visible and even brighter than Venus.
meteor-shower-fireballs.picture: The image shows bright meteors streaking across the night sky. The scene conveys a rare and spectacular astronomical event.

articles.title: Spot rare fireballs during the Southern Taurid meteor shower’s peak - CNN

mars-volcanic-hints.title: Orbiter finds new hints of volcanism on Mars
mars-volcanic-hints.summary: A European orbiter has detected new signs of possible volcanic activity on Mars. Phys.org, National Geographic and Reuters, in their reporting, agree that fresh hints of gas emissions have been spotted above Martian fissures, which may point to ongoing volcanism.
mars-volcanic-hints.picture: The image shows an orbiter flying above the red planet. It indicates that the discovery was made from orbit, not from the Martian surface.

articles.title: European orbiter detects fresh hints of volcanic activity on Mars - Phys.org

cern-rare-decay.title: CERN physicists find traces of an extremely rare particle decay
cern-rare-decay.summary: CERN scientists have reported signs of an extremely rare particle decay detected at the Large Hadron Collider. Euronews writes that, according to calculations, such a process occurs about once in 10 billion cases, giving physicists a new tool for studying matter.
cern-rare-decay.picture: The image shows particle tracks in a ring detector. It symbolizes the accelerator experiment and the search for rare decay signatures.

articles.title: ‘Zeptoverse’: CERN scientists uncover evidence of extraordinarily rare particle decay

swift-telescope-burnup.title: Swift telescope burned up in Earth’s atmosphere after 22 years of operation
swift-telescope-burnup.summary: The Swift space telescope deorbited and burned up in Earth’s atmosphere after 22 years of service. NASA and AP report that the spacecraft completed its mission over Indonesia; the reports also say scientists tried to save it, but without success.
swift-telescope-burnup.picture: The image shows a telescope entering Earth’s atmosphere. This image marks the end of a long orbital mission.

articles.title: Космический телескоп «Свифт» сгорел в атмосфере Земли после 22 лет на орбите. Ученые пытались его спасти, но безуспешно
NASA space telescope plunges to Earth after two decades studying cosmic explosions - AP News

new-zealand-survivors-island.title: Five survivors were rescued from a remote island after months at sea
new-zealand-survivors-island.summary: Five survivors were rescued on a remote island after three months at sea. The NYT reports that a boat from Micronesia went missing in July, and the people reached an island in Kiribati more than 3,000 miles from where they started.
new-zealand-survivors-island.picture: The image shows five people on a tiny island. It highlights their isolation and prolonged survival at sea.

articles.title: After 3 Months Lost at Sea, Five Survivors Are Rescued on Remote Island

zelda-remake-release.title: Zelda re-release hits stores and sparks nostalgia
zelda-remake-release.summary: The re-release of the classic Zelda has gone on sale and sparked a wave of nostalgia among players. AFP reports that Nintendo admitted to feeling nervous ahead of the release, while other reports say fans have welcomed the game warmly.
zelda-remake-release.picture: The image shows a fantasy sword and a game cartridge. It refers to the classic video game and its return to stores.

articles.title: Nintendo producer 'all nervous' as Zelda classic remake hits shelves - AFP.com
Gamers get nostalgic as Zelda remake hits shelves - AFP.com
Gamers set for Zelda remake to hit the shelves - AFP.com

nintendo-profit-slowdown.title: Nintendo’s Switch 2 sales have slowed, but games are keeping results afloat
nintendo-profit-slowdown.summary: Nintendo’s Switch 2 sales have slowed, but game sales have supported the results. The WSJ says half-year profit rose thanks to stronger software sales and the new Mario film, while CNBC and AFP report falling console sales and a decline in quarterly net profit.
nintendo-profit-slowdown.picture: The image shows a handheld console and coins. It illustrates the link between device sales and the company’s financial performance.

articles.title: Nintendo’s First-Half Profit Rose on Stronger Software Sales, New ‘Mario’ Movie - WSJ
Nintendo quarterly net profit drops as Switch 2 unit sales slow - AFP.com

golf-liv-collapse.title: LIV Golf is scaling back plans after losing a key investor
golf-liv-collapse.summary: LIV Golf is scaling back operations after the departure of a key investor and the collapse of relaunch plans. BBC, AP, CNBC and other media report plans to shut down or wind up the project, while The Guardian says player moves to other tournaments are expected during the bankruptcy process. The reports note that the league lacked player backing and funding.
golf-liv-collapse.picture: The image shows a golf ball next to a folded banner. It signifies the winding down of the project and the end of the league’s earlier plans.
